articles.summary: CALGARY, Alberta, April 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TC Energy Corporation (TSX, NYSE: TRP) (TC Energy or the Company) will hold a teleconference and webcast on Friday, May 1, 2026 to discuss its first quarter financial results, and hold its 2026 annual meeting of common shareholders on Thursday, May 7, 2026. articles.title: TC Energy to host first quarter 2026 conference call on May 1 and hold annual meeting of common shareholders on May 7
